sophie: Heads-up: saw a production tail where router fell back to slow compatibility checks because client wanted to 'merge' two nearby commits. No stitch hints carried in rollout metadata.

kenji: do we have a sample request?

sophie: minimal header dump:
```
model_pin: \"infraB:sha-0a1b\"
rollout_metadata: { }
client_opt: \"prefer-stitch\"
```
Runtime enumerated wide and triggered cold path. +1.8s p99.

alex: idea: add `stitch` block to rollout metadata with bounded candidate list + selection mode. Router can try in-memory match first.

maria: strongly prefer bounds: max 4 candidates, per-tenant opt-out, and explicit expiry. We must avoid growing metadata footprint.

sam: and separate semantics: `stitch.mode = \"allow\"` (router may use newer compatible), `\"require\"` (exact-only), `\"probe-only\"` (clients may probe but not auto-route).

kenji: sketch proto: `rollout_metadata.stitch = \"candidates=sha-0a1b,sha-0a2c;mode=allow;expiry=2026-04-01T00:00:00Z\"` (compact single-string fold for wire efficiency).

sophie: runtime needs probe throttling. We saw a client probe loop on startup that evicted KV cache. Need backoff + lease token check.

alex: runtime behavior: prefer in-process candidate match -> if miss, check local cache -> if still miss and mode=allow, issue bounded async probe (respecting probe_policy) before taking slow compatibility path.

maria: console/telemetry: surface `stitch_probe_rate`, `stitch_success_rate`, and `stitch_auto_routing_rate`. Ops should be able to mute client-specific probes.

sam: testing: add flaky scenarios: partial candidate overlap, candidate expiry mid-request, tenants with provenance lock. Also simulate startup probe storms.

deploy-bot: schema-augment-v1 -> canary deploy started (id: schema-aug-v1-202604) :rocket:

kenji: migration: accept legacy `stitch_hint` string for 90 days and emit deprecation warnings. Then flip to structured field.

sophie: actionables:
- kenji: draft compact rollout_metadata.stitch wire format + RFC (due 48h)
- alex: implement router fast-path + probe backoff (start with canary)
- maria: client-sdk: implement probe_policy; add tenant opt-out flag
- sam: add telemetry + e2e matrix for edge cases
I'll create the RFC PR and link tests to the canary.

alex: minor: add a limit that stitch candidates cannot reference models from different tenants. Avoid cross-tenant accidental routing.

maria: noted. Also log one-off stitch_refuses for debugging.

kenji: will post draft in #architecture tomorrow morning.

sophie: thanks all. Tight timeline but looks small & high impact.
